Body.Content:
Native connectors support through Power Pages will allow organizations to securely connect their websites/portals directly to enterprise systems such as SQL, SAP, and Oracle, without building or maintaining custom integration layers.

This capability is especially valuable for regulated and enterprise customers such as banking and financial services, who need to surface data from systems hosted behind corporate firewalls. By leveraging the Power Platform on-premises data gateway and connector framework, customers can reduce integration complexity, lower operational costs, and accelerate delivery of secure digital experiences.

Customers benefit from consistent security, governance, and compliance with existing Power Platform policies, while gaining the flexibility to build server-side logic that can interact with on-premises data sources.

GA date: June CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
